### Things That Strangle Us
Author: Pastor Chuck Swindoll
Site: Insight for Living
URL: https://insight.org/resources/daily-devotional/individual/things-that-strangle-us
Passage: Mark 4:19
Points:
- Merely hearing God's Word guarantees nothing if it is not received and nurtured in the heart.
- The thorny ground represents hearers whose spiritual vitality is choked before any harvest is produced.
- Anxiety begins quietly but can steadily carve deep channels that dominate our thoughts.
- Pursuing wealth proves deceptive and empty, distracting us from what truly satisfies.
- Continual discontentment and craving more things serve as fertilizer for choking thorns.

### The Spiritual Practice of Weeding
Author: Sophia Bricker
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-nightly-prayer/the-spiritual-practice-of-weeding.html
Passage: Matthew 13:22
Points:
- Unchecked weeds can slowly overpower and kill even sturdy, well-established plants.
- Anxiety over daily necessities and the desire for riches prevent God's Word from flourishing.
- Disciples need the regular spiritual discipline of uprooting destructive thoughts and habits.
- Cultivating good soil in the heart requires practicing contentment and prioritizing God's kingdom.
